summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Foreign Trade Bank of Latin America, Inc. (Bladex), a foreign private issuer, reporting the Board's approval of a quarterly cash dividend of US$0.6875 per share for Q1 2026. The dividend is payable on May 27, 2026 to holders of record on May 8, 2026. The filing contains no special-situation elements such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other transformative event. It is a routine dividend announcement, which does not constitute a special situation.
